facts.fact: Dal Mare 在七具被开膛的孩子尸身旁擦汗；预言确认他需要 Michele 的血；他派 Wedge 追 Michele，但更想策反 Cavaterra 一家
清晨 Giada 与 Wendy 河边洗浴、互相挑逗；发现树影里 Peter 裸身自渎，他的注视把玩笑变成失控的自渎，一滴精液隔岸落到 Wendy 发间，她当作圣餐吞下
facts.anchor: Wendy accepts the sacrament of the god.

facts.fact: 营地：Filippo 八岁已是纯熟杀手（在 Flesh 口吃、在 Enchantment 不口吃）；双子玩 Imaginary Enemies，唯禁 Goku 与 Peter Pan
facts.anchor: at eight years old he’s already an accomplished killer

facts.fact: Peter 对今晚作战只说「今晚就是今晚，我不会让它毁掉我今天」；Giovanni 质问宣战演说，Peter 只给结果不给方法
facts.anchor: “Tonight’s tonight. I’m not going to let it ruin my day.”

facts.fact: Wendy 花一小时讲「带一队会飞的孩子攻打海盗船」，被欢呼授职 Exalted Strategist，获赠一张澳大利亚地图；Giada 判「这将是一场屠杀」
facts.anchor: This is going to be a massacre

facts.fact: 三人讨论三 Aspects：Giovanni 说是「视角」，Wendy 说戏法与魔法没有区别，Giovanni 心里想今夜要靠奇迹
Hook 在船头独白：恨纸墨之力、要最后的战争、人该得到和平与秩序；随后登船是空船陷阱，海盗从各处涌出
facts.anchor: soon Hook will free himself from the power of paper and ink

facts.fact: 孩子们与海盗打成平手（武器小、动作快、能飞、不可预测）；Wendy 与 Giada 替 Giovanni 挡住五名海盗，他先去找牢房
牢中 Luisa 听见厮杀、后悔没把秘密告诉 Giovanni；进来的是 Smee（即 Fatty），一剑穿透她右眼杀死她
facts.anchor: Luisa feels the metal pierce her right eye

facts.fact: Hook 以西西里神父祝圣的网擒住 Tinker Bell（圣物灼伤她的本性），把她拖进大理石船（Flesh）再换回 Enchantment，把剑塞回她手中、旁边是 Luisa 尚温的尸体；Fatty 谎称 Peter 要杀 Luisa，把 Giovanni 引到现场；Giovanni 嚎叫着攻击仙女，仙女跃窗撤退，他抱起 Luisa，只剩眼泪
facts.anchor: All that’s left are tears, and nothing more.

numbers.anchor: There are five of them, swords drawn.
it takes Wendy more than an hour

relations.what: 即 Fatty/Stranieri 导师，亲手杀 Luisa
relations.anchor: Fatty does, or Smee, whatever he calls himself in this Aspect.

relations.what: 被祝圣之网擒走，成为 Hook 的筹码
relations.anchor: the blessed weave burns her very nature

relations.what: 即 Augusto Dal Mare，要 Michele 的血、想策反 Cavaterra 一家
relations.anchor: he’d rather convert them to his cause
